description:
The Bible says that Christ came to redeem us from the curse of law. If that is so, do we still follow the Old Testament laws and tithe? Find out the answers to these questions and many more on this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Is the Prince of the Kingdom of Persia, Satan or the Antichrist? Did Daniel not know that Michael, his prince, was in fact the reincarnated Christ? Is it because Jesus Christ had not yet come to earth and had not been crucified at the time of Daniel's visions?  

2.   I love to dance. My friend asked me if Seventh-day Adventists dance. Do we? Is it a sin to dance?      
 
3.  When we love God and follow his commandments and love our neighbors as ourselves, Can we ever say we are righteous? 
 
4.  Acts 12:4 KJV, is the only time that Easter is mentioned in the Bible. How come, we, as Christians conform to the pagan ways of worshipping the gods of fertility? Why do Christians celebrate pagan holidays?

5.  What is the image of jealousy in Ezekiel 8:5? 
 
6.  When Christ came to earth he died for our sins and it is said that he fulfilled the Old Testament. Does this mean we aren't supposed to follow the Old Testament anymore because He fulfilled it? What does Galatians 3:24 mean that we are no longer under the law? Do we still follow the Old Testament?

7. The EU has decided to introduce insect flowers from larvae, crickets, and grasshoppers into flour and in many other foods like pastries, pasta, etc. Are these things clean or unclean? If they are in flour that means we won't be able to eat bread and things made of flour. I think that these creeping things are called an abomination in the Bible. How can we solve this problem and stay faithful to the Bible and to the health laws? Are these bugs’ flowers harmful to our health? Is it Biblical to eat insects?

8.  Can you explain Isaiah 25:6? Some members of my church think we will be drinking wine and eating meat. 

9.  Israel was commanded to tithe. They were told if they didn't tithe they would be cursed. Yet Galatians 3:13 says Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law. Do we still need to tithe? 

10.  Why can't Satan simply kill all sinners at one time if he is really seeking to destroy souls? The Bible states that the sole agenda of Satan is to steal, kill, and destroy. Can Satan kill sinners anytime he wants to? 
 
11.  Can a truly justified soul lose salvation? 
 
12.   Will we need the Everlasting Gospel when we get to Heaven?
